FROM FIN_PRODUCT T -- LEFT JOIN REP_PROD_ISSUE I /*发行*/ ON I.REP_FINPROD_ID = T.Finprod_Id LEFT JOIN REP_PROD_DECLARE D -- ON D.REP_FINPROD_ID = T.Finprod_Id LEFT JOIN fin_product_add TA -- ON t.finprod_id =TA.finprod_id
LEFT JOIN PA_FIN_PRODUCT PFP -- ON t.finprod_id =PFP.finprod_id
LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE FC -- ON t.finprod_id =FC.finprod_id
LEFT JOIN PRD_SALE_PARAM psp -- ON t.finprod_id =psp.finprod_id
LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO CASH -- ON CASH.FINPROD_ID = T.FINPROD_ID and cash.cash_type_2 ='C01' and cash.finprod_type='01'
LEFT JOIN FIN_OPEN_RULE R -- ON R.CASH_ID = CASH.CASH_ID and r.open_type in ('01','03')
LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO CASH1 -- ON CASH1.FINPROD_ID = ifnull(T.p_finprod_id,T.FINPROD_ID) and CASH1.cash_type_1 = '02' and CASH1.cash_type_2 = 'C02' and CASH1.BRANCH = '0'
LEFT JOIN fin_rate_info Rateinfo -- ON Rateinfo.CASH_ID = CASH1.CASH_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT P_FINPROD_ID, group_concat(TAR_CUSTOMER_TYPE,',') TYPE FROM PRD_LAYER_PARAM GROUP BY P_FINPROD_ID ) TINFO ON TINFO.P_FINPROD_ID = T.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN stl_fin_product_acct sfpa on sfpa.finprod_id=T.finprod_id and sfpa.acct_type = 'A01' LEFT JOIN stl_capacct_info sci ON sfpa.ACCT_NO = sci.ACCT_NO
